value.rationale: Gaussian graphical independence is characterized exactly by a zero precision cofactor. This theorem locates the only conditional-independence configuration for the smallest symmetric irregular circular sampling design, proves strict sign regimes, yields parameter-independent threshold bounds, and determines sharp small/large heat-time limits. These distinctions matter for modeling negative versus positive partial dependence and choosing sparse conditional approximations; the classification is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
